facts.fact: The World Bank reports three interagency information-sharing protocols signed by the Agency for Social Protection, against a baseline of zero in July 2019 and a target of three, with the social registry still at 0% of the 60% beneficiary target (pending the ASP MIS) as at 30 May 2025.

note: Names an existing beneficiary registry and payment systems used for REPAIR cash transfers but states no data exchange between systems.
Cabinet approves PwC stabilisation support for ASP Connect in 2026 and DICT-led government ownership; it states no data exchange with the ID, payments or other programmes.

facts.fact: Seychelles Nation reports the Agency for Social Protection's ASP Connect system, launched internally on 15 October 2025, is accessible through the SeyID portal; the free text names no data exchanged with the ID, a payment provider or another programme.

note: Body is paywalled after the lede; the link to SeyID is access through the portal only.
Sensitisation launch for eSPS, go-live planned Q3 2025; no exchange, registry sharing or linkage is stated.

systems.system: National database of applicants for and beneficiaries of social assistance

note: Statute requires ASP to keep a national database of applicants and beneficiaries; it states no exchange with other systems, shared use by programmes or linkage to ID.
Procurement notice of 2026-09-03 for consultants to draft a health-sector interoperability framework; a plan with nothing contracted, delivered or adopted, and no statement on this study.
